turnaround_reason: Coty fell to ~$2.68 (from a 52w high of $4.47) on soft consumer-beauty demand, repeated EPS misses, and a heavy debt load. The recovery pitch is a cost-savings program (~$200M targeted), a closed US prestige-fragrance sell-out gap, and debt paydown from divesting the Gucci Beauty license back to Kering.
bullish_points: Cost program delivering: >$40M productivity + >$10M fixed-cost savings in Q1 FY26, ~$200M targeted for the year
US prestige-fragrance sell-out gap to the market closed (from ~5pts in Q4 FY25 to full alignment); mgmt guides return to sales/profit growth in 2H FY26
Gucci Beauty license transitions back to Kering for ~$400M, earmarked for debt paydown and core reinvestment
Deep-value optics: forward P/E ~10.5, P/B 0.79, EV/EBITDA 7.4, positive FCF ~$363M; one notable insider open-market buy (Von Bretten 83k @ $2.41)
bearish_points: Debt is the whole story: $3.3B total debt, D/E ~97, current ratio 0.755, and negative operating (-2.4%) and profit (-10.4%) margins
Recent earnings have missed badly (Aug reported -$0.02 vs -$0.01; May -$0.03 with a -728% surprise)
Analyst mean target $2.689 is essentially the current price - the Street sees no upside; rec 'hold'
JAB controls ~59% of shares; float is thin (376M of 881M) and minority holders have limited influence
Dossier ATM IV of 6.25% looks like bad option data for a sub-$3 name; don't rely on the options read
catalyst: 2H FY26 return to sales/profit growth confirmed on the print, plus visible debt reduction from the Gucci proceeds
suggested_trade: Spot only, small speculative deep-value tranche; wait for one clean beat + debt-reduction proof before adding
key_risk: Consumer-beauty demand stays soft and another EPS miss forces the market to refocus on the leverage, pressuring the equity toward the $1.82 low
would_skip_if: Next print misses again or 2H FY26 growth guidance is walked back; leverage leaves no margin for operational error
